title: XML dispatch accepts response-only handlers on inbound clients
summary: Inbound XML has NULL device context but dispatches response-only handlers that dereference/assert device, allowing a small invalid-direction element to terminate server. Next: enforce direction-specific allowlists and test all message forms in both directions. Confirmed by current source contracts; no fix or runtime retest claimed.
